subject: Order Tuesday 13/10 - Hotel Keizersloot
body:
Good morning,

Please deliver the following tomorrow (Tuesday 13/10), before 08:00 if possible as the breakfast team starts at 06:30.

- Whole milk 1L: 5 cases
- Semi-skimmed 1L: 3 cases
- Orange juice 1L: 3 cases
- Cloudy apple juice 1L: 2 cases
- Greek yoghurt: 3 cases
- Mini croissants: 1 box
- Caffè Crema beans: 4 bags

Goods entrance on the Leliegracht side as usual. Ruud from the kitchen is in cc in case the driver has questions.

Kind regards,

Mark Bosman
F&B Manager
Hotel Keizersloot
Keizersgracht 318, 1016 EZ Amsterdam
T +31 20 624 1187
